title: Restrictions on International Travellers to Prevent Import on COVID-19 Cases
what_it_is: Restrictions on International Travellers to Prevent Import on COVID-19 Cases

sections.label: Reopening borders for safe travel
sections.summary: Borders will gradually reopen to safe international travel, starting with green lane arrangements with low-case countries.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In line with our phased resumption of activities safely from 2 June after circuit breaker, we will also gradually reopen our borders to safe international travel.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This will initially comprise green lane arrangements with countries that have low numbers of cases and rates of transmission.

sections.label: Singapore-China green lane launch
sections.summary: The first green lane arrangement launches on 8 June between Singapore and six Chinese provinces or municipalities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: As announced on 3 June, the first green lane arrangement will be launched on 8 June between Singapore and six Chinese provinces or municipalities, namely Chongqing, Guangdong, Jiangsu, Shanghai, Tianjin and Zhejiang.

sections.label: PCR test before travel to China
sections.summary: Travellers to China must take a PCR test within 48 hours of departure and test negative to get a SafeTravel pass.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: For the individual, based on the current arrangements with China, before you travel to China, you would have to take a PCR test within 48 hours of departure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: And you must be tested negative to have a SafeTravel pass, which you must show before you are allowed to board the plane.

sections.label: Tests for travellers from China
sections.summary: Travellers coming from China into Singapore will take one test before departure and another upon arrival.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The same is true for travellers coming from China into Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: There will also be two tests: one test before departure and another test upon arrival.

sections.label: Low community cases prerequisite
sections.summary: The important prerequisite for establishing a green lane is that community cases in both countries stay low and controlled.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The important prerequisite for green lane to be established is that the community cases in both countries must be kept low and under control.
